title: Meme Trojan: Backdoor Attacks Against Hateful Meme Detection via Cross-Modal Triggers

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the vulnerability of hateful meme detectors to cross-modal backdoor attacks by measuring Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Clean Data Accuracy (CDA) on the FBHM dataset, which includes memes containing racial hate.

Evaluating the vulnerability of hateful meme detectors to cross-modal backdoor attacks by measuring Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Clean Data Accuracy (CDA) on the FBHM dataset, which includes memes containing religious hate.

Evaluating the vulnerability of hateful meme detectors to cross-modal backdoor attacks by measuring Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Clean Data Accuracy (CDA) using the MAMI dataset (focused on misogyny) and the FBHM dataset.

Evaluating the vulnerability of hateful meme detectors to cross-modal backdoor attacks by measuring Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Clean Data Accuracy (CDA) on the FBHM dataset, which includes memes targeting specific nationalities.

Evaluating the vulnerability of hateful meme detectors to cross-modal backdoor attacks by measuring Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Clean Data Accuracy (CDA) on the FBHM dataset, which includes memes targeting disabilities.

Evaluating the vulnerability of hateful meme detectors to cross-modal backdoor attacks by measuring Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Clean Data Accuracy (CDA) on the HarMeme dataset, which features memes related to US elections and COVID-19.
